subject: [PATCH 42/60] mm: fail private placement on exhaustion instead of OOM killing

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to improve handling of private memory allocation failures by failing allocations instead of killing tasks when a private zonelist is exhausted. However, the discussion has not yet progressed beyond the initial posting.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses private memory allocation failures by modifying the OOM killer's behavior to fail allocations instead of killing tasks when a private zonelist is exhausted. The changes involve adding a new flag to track private allocation failures and updating various functions in the mm module to handle these cases.
